narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>There are so many multiples of eleven. Some must fail when doubled, so Deepak must be right.
<bookmark mark='list'/>Nobody has ever found a multiple of eleven that fails when doubled.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Guessing is not a reason, so let us look at the form.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, double any multiple of eleven and divide by eleven.
<bookmark mark='whole'/>You always get a whole number, because the rows of eleven stay full.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu guesses that some multiple must fail, so Deepak must be right. Two times eleven k is eleven times two k, so none fails.
